Reasoning: This stage moves the robot fingertip into contact with mug_rim_frame_0 while the gripper remains open and the fingertip orientation is held fixed. The open_gripper term maintains the open finger configuration. The freeze_orientation term preserves the current panda_fingertip orientation, representing fixed world-frame directions of its tool +z and +y axes from the start of the stage. The reach_point term drives the panda_fingertip origin to the mug_rim_frame_0 origin with the required 0.01 m contact tolerance. Its condition includes both geometry and manipulator_high_effort to represent the requested geometric contact tolerance together with touch/effort feedback as the stopping indication. Detailed monitoring of pose, joint state, and contact feedback is runtime instrumentation and is not separately expressible as a Constraint term.
